title: gVisor User-Space Kernel Isolation: Sentry Syscall Interception, Gofer FD Proxies & Immutable Sandbox Specs
author: ontology-spider-learning-wave

edges.description: Repository google/gvisor at commit b6c312b83f13d6150a3386bd1f7c170ba2342cc4; surfaced by Ontology-Spider as unlearned top-level repository
Informs Brain Harness subprocess and container isolation architecture

claims.assertion: gVisor intercepts guest System APIs inside a pure-Go user-space kernel (Sentry) without CGo, prohibiting direct host syscall passthrough, isolating unsafe into *unsafe.go files, and delegating host filesystem access to separate Gofer processes over connected sockets.

runsc manages lifecycle state via an immutable Sandbox struct that separates filesystem Gofer endpoints (IOFiles, DevIOFile, GoferMountConfs) from execution via explicit FD donation (DonateAndClose) and uRPC socket control.
The pkg/sentry/platform/platform.go Platform interface decouples guest context and address-space interception from underlying host seccomp/ptrace/KVM virtualization substrates.

distilled_learning: Isolate untrusted agent execution via defense-in-depth user-space mediation: separate filesystem broker processes (Gofer) from kernel/syscall mediation (Sentry), pass pre-opened file descriptors rather than raw filesystem paths, and isolate unsafe/CGo-free boundaries.
